data.summary: The Random‑forest PD challenger model was evaluated as a benchmark against the champion. Its Gini — train is {{m:run_098fd6:gini.train}}, Gini — test is {{m:run_098fd6:gini.test}}, Gini — out‑of‑time (simulated) is {{m:run_098fd6:gini.oot}}, KS — out‑of‑time is {{m:run_098fd6:ks.oot}}, AUC — hold‑out is {{m:run_098fd6:auc.holdout}}, Brier score — hold‑out is {{m:run_098fd6:brier.holdout}}, Predicted × observed — hold‑out is {{m:run_098fd6:calibration_ratio.holdout}}, Observed outcome rate — hold‑out is {{m:run_098fd6:bad_rate.holdout}}, Approval rate at coded cutoff is {{m:run_098fd6:approval_rate.holdout}}, Champion Gini — hold‑out is {{m:run_098fd6:gini.champion.holdout}} and Challenger Gini — hold‑out is {{m:run_098fd6:gini.challenger.holdout}}. The number of high‑severity findings is {{m:run_098fd6:findings.high}}, the number of medium‑severity findings is {{m:run_098fd6:findings.medium}} and the total number of findings is {{m:run_098fd6:findings.total}}. Key issues include a high‑severity finding that the challenger was trained and assessed on the same rows, medium‑severity findings related to approval‑rate disparity by age band, direct use of age and personal status/sex, and a low‑severity hardcoded shared‑drive path. The overall rating is Requires remediation before continued use.
